name: v1_fixed_x_tuning
description: Nested patient-grouped CV evaluation of bilateral-mean VF PCA with fixed X-only-selected image hyperparameters.
notes: PCA and VF standardization are fit independently inside every training fold.
Each patient receives equal total PCA weight across repeated visits.
Sex is excluded from PCA and evaluated separately.
Inner CV selects only K; CFP/ROI S, R, h, and hbar remain fixed at the existing X-only-selected values.
This experiment tests bilateral OD/OS-mean VF covariates, not eye-specific VF effects.
ridge=1e-6 is a numerical stabilization choice.
